citations.desc: Attending veterinarian and adequate veterinary care.
citations.narrative:
The facility does not have an approved written program of veterinary care with regularly scheduled visits to the research
facility. The attending veterinarian accepted the position on May 27, 2026, after being appointed by the CEO of the
research facility under formal arrangements, but has not yet approved a written program of veterinary care with regularly
scheduled visits to the facility. Although regulated species and activities are not performed at the institution at this time, all
USDA registrants are required to have a formal arrangement documented in writing and is necessary to assure veterinary
oversight over the care and use of the animals at the facility. The formal arrangement between the facility and the part-
time consulting veterinarian shall include a written program of veterinary care and regularly scheduled visits to the
research facility.
Correct by: 09/01/2026.

The research facility still had not submitted their USDA fiscal year 2025 (FY25) Annual Report to the Deputy Administrator
on or before the extended deadline due date of 12/31/25 since the last inspection. Per this Section, research facilities that
use or intend to use live animals in research, tests, experiments, or for teaching shall submit an annual report, that covers
the numbers of animals used during the previous Federal fiscal year, to the Deputy Administrator on or before the
December due date in this Subchapter of the AWA. Timely submission of the annual report is essential to provide an
accurate accounting of the total number of animals used and to ensure that professionally acceptable standards
governing the care and use of animals were followed during the previous Federal fiscal year reporting period. The
research facility needs to submit their USDA FY25 Annual Report.
Corrected at time of inspection.
This inspection and exit interview were conducted with facility representatives.
